SELECT
            t.oid AS "oid!",
            t.typnamespace AS "namespace!",
            t.typname AS "name!",
            t.typtype::text AS "typtype!",
            NULLIF(t.typrelid, 0::oid) AS "relation_oid?"
        FROM pg_type t
        WHERE t.typtype IN ('e', 'c', 'r')
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c
            WHERE c.reltype = t.oid
              AND c.relkind != 'c'
          )
        ORDER BY t.oid

SELECT
            t.oid AS "oid!",

            t.typname AS "name!",
            t.typtype::text AS "typtype!",
            NULLIF(t.typrelid, 0::oid) AS "relation_oid?"

          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c
            WHERE c.oid = t.typrelid
              AND c.relkind <> 'c'
          )
        ORDER BY t.oid
